adaptations: Optional CUDA graph helper replaced by explicit eager execution for bundled Torch 2.0.
Host worker owns explicit device and precision instead of importing modern WebUI configs.config; duplicate resample initialization removed. Upstream model architecture and checkpoint layout retained.
Checkpoint deserialization explicitly uses weights_only=True and has no unsafe pickle fallback.
deserialization_authority: Adapter authenticates immutable bytes before passing an in-memory stream to bundled Torch; user-selected RMVPE artifacts are not accepted.
